'''Viktor Yevgenyevich Panin''' ({{langx|ru|Виктор Евгеньевич Панин}}; 10 November 1930 – 25 September 2020) was a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] and [[Russia]]n physicist, professor, and advisor of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. He was an expert in the fields of [[solid mechanics]], [[Deformation (physics)|plastic deformation]] and [[Materials science|physical materials]].

==Curriculum vitae==
* 1979 — Head of Solid State Physics and Materials Science at the Institute of Atmospheric Optics, [[Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union]]
* From 1984 to 2002 — founder and director of [[Institute of Strength Physics and Materials Science SB RAS]]
* From 2002 to present — Adviser Academy of Sciences of Institute of Strength Physics and Materials Science SB RAS

He was a Foreign Member of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Belarus]] since 1999.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://nasb.gov.by/rus/members/mbrshf.php |title = Карта сайта}}</ref>

==Scientific achievements==
Under the guidance of academician Viktor Panin who established and developed [[physical mesomechanics]] of materials, uniting [[Materials science|physical materials]] with [[solid mechanics]] at macrolevel and with physics of [[Deformation (physics)|plastic deformation]] at microlevel. Within this framework, he developed new methods of computer design materials and technologies of their production.<ref>[http://vital.lib.tsu.ru/vital/access/manager/Repository/vtls:000011317?letter=%D0%95 Physical mesomechanics and computer engineering design of materials (''rus'')]</ref> Deep mesomechanics ideas can be successfully used in the new approach to [[earthquake prediction]] where the [[seismic source]] mesostructure appears to be an intermediate term precursor.<ref>[[Sergey Goldin|Goldin S. V.]] Macro- and mesostructures in the earthquake source area // Физическая мезомеханика. 2005. Т. 8. № 1. сс. 5-14 (''rus'')  {{cite web|url=http://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/makro-i-mezostruktury-ochagovoy-oblasti-zemletryaseniya |title=МАКРО- И МЕЗОСТРУКТУРЫ ОЧАГОВОЙ ОБЛАСТИ ЗЕМЛЕТРЯСЕНИЯ - тема научной статьи по геологии, читайте бесплатно текст научно-исследовательской работы в электронной библиотеке КиберЛенинка |accessdate=February 28, 2015 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150214093555/http://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/makro-i-mezostruktury-ochagovoy-oblasti-zemletryaseniya |archivedate=February 14, 2015 }}</ref>
